title: About Pressure Section for a Held Signal
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1209 recent saved-signal files and 320 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @ABLO_Official: Origin Summit 2025 was 🔥🔥🔥 and here's a little recap of what happened at... and @DorkSirjur: Coming in next today its a group of techno icons, 34 years ago: This is Underground..., plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Pressure Section for a Held Signal: Pressure section for a held signal: an architectural section in side-lit object-slab grammar, vertical left-heavy pale aluminum panel filled with recessed black rounded connector voids, clean off-white silence to the right. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against black diagonal glass aperture, pale diagonal torn seam through perforations, and upper-left translucent recessed plate over slot grid.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
